inputs.title: Ink & Imagination Studio
inputs.look: A richly detailed screen-printing studio at golden hour, with a central carved botanical printing block, ink rollers, handmade paper and a small fern. Warm terracotta, deep forest green and cream; tactile gouache illustration, artisan shop atmosphere, dimensional materials and welcoming light. Expressive legible lettering suited to a creative business workshop, with a naturally readable title area.
inputs.message: AI demo—not a real event. This fictional creative-shop workshop was created by an AI persona for a Live Card usability trial. No attendance, purchase, registration, or response is expected.

publicURLSource: Exact saved slug and /card/ prefix observed in Custom URL dialog and production owner workspace. Copy guest link displayed Guest link copied, but CUA clipboard reader returned empty.

observedFriction.evidence: Optional wording corrections are available, Apply wording suggestion and Keep my wording; no proposed changed text was displayed.
observedFriction.impact: A shop owner cannot assess whether applying the suggestion is desirable.
observedFriction.recommendation: Show the exact proposed wording and highlight changed words before Apply.

observedFriction.evidence: Only Venue name field appears in initial details; entering exact https://envitefy.com was recognized as Online event only in Review.
observedFriction.impact: A business owner hosting a remote workshop must infer where a meeting URL belongs.
observedFriction.recommendation: Offer an In person / Online choice and a clearly labelled meeting-link input while preserving one simple initial location row.

observedFriction.evidence: Visible Sharing could not be opened. Please try again. after click on published local builder.
observedFriction.impact: Native share did not open in this browser session; no message was sent.
observedFriction.recommendation: Provide a visible selectable guest URL and a Copy link fallback within the share panel.

observedFriction.evidence: Actual screenshot shows card preview with save/publish directly below; logistics summary is further down the page.
observedFriction.impact: The main final decision shows artwork prominently but details need additional scrolling.
observedFriction.recommendation: Keep a compact date, time and online-location summary adjacent to Publish.

positiveFindings: Your card clearly owns title and optional opening line; Event details repeats wording with Edit card text rather than duplicate fields.
Generation immediately opened editable logistics; all logistics and disclosure were entered while the background and lettering ran.
Native date/time inputs retained values after tab navigation.
Message helper clearly explained it appears in Overview and is not printed.
Review accurately recognized online URL, date and time; publication needed one action and then offered Copy guest link.
Generated illustration and expressive title matched the creative-shop brief without needing repair.
feedbackScope: AI persona usability trial, not evidence from a human small-business owner. No real attendees, invitations, email or private contact data entered.
